$comment: Catala rule test inputs for PaInheritanceTaxCharge per ICP-0017 (TT-682). Pennsylvania inheritance tax charge, 72 P.S. § 9116(a). Scope returns ComputedOrNeedsHuman.Verdict (money), not a bespoke verdict enum, so expected_output records the arm + (for Computed) the amount. Mirrors the oracle cases authored for the code-inherit-test-suite T032 gov-oracle follow-up (tests/oracles/pa-inheritance-tax.oracle.json) — figures live-sourced revenue.pa.gov / 20 Pa.C.S. § 3121 2026-07-02.

positive.decidability_claim: DECIDABLE; $100,000 x 4.5% = $4,500 (72 P.S. § 9116(a), direct descendants and lineal heirs).

negative.decidability_claim: DECIDABLE; 0% on transfers to a surviving spouse (72 P.S. § 9116(a)) — structural exemption, not a zero-valued rate.

edge.decidability_claim: NOT DECIDABLE BY RULE; a claimed family exemption (20 Pa.C.S. § 3121) or § 9111 exemption needs human adjudication of eligibility before a figure can be computed.
